The brand explicitly connects sound and food as its design concept and has a multi-model overdrive/distortion/fuzz catalog. WTKG remains outside central dirt as a clean/treble booster. Limited SPICY KATSU CURRY is a collaboration/2in1 edition rather than a separate conceptual model.
